component.name: Cosmic Applet Crypto
component.summary: Live cryptocurrency prices in the COSMIC panel

description.p: Shows live cryptocurrency prices in the COSMIC panel. The panel carries one coin's price at a glance; the popup lists every coin you track with its 24h change and a seven-day sparkline.

ul.li: Track any coin listed on CoinGecko, added by ticker, name, or id
Seven-day price sparkline on every row
Prices in any fiat currency CoinGecko quotes
Panel label detail is adjustable, down to an icon alone on vertical panels
Prices are cached, so a restart shows the last known figures immediately
No API key and no account required

description.p: Price data comes from the CoinGecko public API. The applet contacts api.coingecko.com and nothing else.

screenshot.caption: Tracked coins with their 24h change and seven-day trend
